Class GameObject

java.lang.Object
com.phase2.GameObjects.GameObject
Direct Known Subclasses:
Doug, Exit, MovingEnemy, Obstacle, Punishment, Reward
public abstract class GameObject extends Object
The GameObject class is an abstract class representing all objects in the game. It defines common properties like position (x, y) and velocity (velX, velY) for game objects. Subclasses must define how the object behaves and renders.

      public abstract void render(Graphics g)
